result:
Typecheck passes clean and `bun test` reports 4 pass / 0 fail (the stack trace in the output is pre-existing log noise from the starter test that intentionally triggers a 422).

The regression was entirely in `app/Http/Resources/PostResource.ts`: the last deploy dropped `excerpt` from the object returned by `toArray()`, and at the same time removed the `: PostResourceData` return-type annotation that would have made TypeScript reject the missing field — which is why the data stayed intact in the database (search still queries the `excerpt` column directly) while every page that reads it off the serialized resource went blank. I restored both the `excerpt: post.excerpt as string` line and the explicit return type, so the list cards, the show page's byline paragraph, and the edit form's initial values get the stored text again, and any future field drop fails `bun run typecheck` instead of silently shipping. I also added `tests/PostResource.test.ts`, a DB-free unit test asserting the resource serializes `excerpt` both for a single post and through `PostResource.collection()` (the path `posts.search` uses); nothing else was touched.
